value.original: Export as Primavera P6 PMXML (APIBusinessObjects XML) — the format every documented P6 export path uses; re-imports here too. Some fields (WBS code, EPS-level activity codes, resource assignments, global calendars, baselines) are not carried — P6 itself drops most of these on cross-DB import.

row.value: Voer uit as Primavera P6 PMXML (APIBusinessObjects XML) — die formaat wat elke gedokumenteerde P6-uitvoerpad gebruik; kan ook hier weer ingevoer word.
